line.en: A felt-tip marker on the glass in front of the person's own footage or screen recording.

for.en: Hand-drawn highlighter marks over your own footage or screen recording: unboxings, tutorials, commentary. Needs your own video.
for.zh-CN: 叠在你自己画面或录屏上的手绘荧光笔标注：开箱、教程、解说。需要你自己的视频。

not.en: Films with no footage of their own.
